_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Hazardous Materials Management Program (HMMP) Report
summary: The HMMP Report identifies hazardous materials in a system and its operation and maintenance, and documents the contractor's efforts to eliminate or reduce associated HAZMAT risk.
use_relationship:
The Hazardous Materials Management Program (HMMP) Report identifies the Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) in the system and that are used for operation and maintenance of the system, and it documents the results of the contractor's efforts to eliminate or reduce the HAZMAT risk associated with the system, system component, or support item being acquired. It is applicable to the acquisition of systems, system components, and associated support items during the current and future acquisition phases and sustainment.
a. The HMMP Report is used to document the program's status in identifying and reducing HAZMAT risks. The report also supports compliance with the requirements of relevant laws, presidential executive orders, and the regulations that implement those laws and orders.
b. This Data Item Description (DID) is intended for use by system acquisition program offices responsible for acquiring or modifying systems where the Aerospace Industries Association (AIA) National Aerospace Standard (NAS) 411, Hazardous Materials Management Program, is used as the basis for the HMMP Report. (Copies of this document are available online at https://www.aia-aerospace.org/standards).
c. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in 5.3 of NAS411; NAS411-1, Hazardous Material Target List (copies of this document are available online at https://www.aia-aerospace.org/standards); Task 108 of MIL-STD-882, System Safety (copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil); and as recommended in NAS411 (Appendix A and B), use SAE International (SAE) GEIA-STD-0007, Logistics Product Data (copies of this document are available online at https://www.sae.org).
d. This DID can be used with DI-MGMT-81398, Hazardous Material Management Program (HMMP) Plan. This DID is related to: DI-ENVR-81840, Programmatic Environmental Safety and Health Evaluation (PESHE) Plan; DI-SAFT-81626, System Safety Program Plan (SSPP); DI-SAFT-80101, System Safety Hazard Analysis Report (SSHAR); DI-SAFT-80102, Safety Assessment Report (SAR); DI-SAFT-80106, Health Hazard Assessment Report (HHAR); DI-SAFT-82085, Hazard Tracking System (HTS) Data; DI-SAFT-81841, Operating, Support, Health, and Safety (OSH&S) Hazard Analysis Report; DI-SAFT-82239, Environmental Hazard Analysis (EHA) Report; DI-SESS-81758, Logistics Product Data; and DI-SESS-81759, Logistics Product Data Summaries. (Copies of these documents are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil).
e. This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81397C.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The HMMP Report data format shall comply with Appendices A and B of NAS411 to enable digital data transfer and data analysis.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The HMMP Report shall identify the HAZMAT in the system or that are used for operation and maintenance of the system. The HMMP Report shall address HAZMAT risks in contractually-specified systems, system components, and associated operations and support materials during the current and all future life cycle phases and activities. The HMMP Report shall include the information required by NAS411, section HMMP Report Content, including all subparagraphs, and the data required in Appendix A, HMMP Report Data Fields.

children.title: An HMMP Plan
children.content: When an HMMP Plan is required by the same contract, the HMMP Report shall be consistent with the HMMP Plan (see DI-MGMT-81398).
